rapport_notes: Polite and clear despite a bad phone connection the customer flagged repeatedly; no real warmth-building, straight to business.
top_strength: Itemized exactly what was being moved (hospital bed, dresser, etc.) clearly with no wasted questions.
coaching_note: Never gave a time-range anchor before quoting the hourly rate and minimum, so the customer had nothing to compare the number against and balked immediately; also no attempt to hold the objection or re-pitch value once she said it was too much.
